Name: Aki's Yuji Itadori Portraits
Author: AkiNoKage
Description:
This is a portrait mod for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23955]Itadori Yuji mod[/url]﻿ by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/207508887]yujihat[/url].

There are two versions. One with scars, one without. Scars are set to default. If you want to change it, you can do so with Generic Mod Config Menu in the game.
